title: Mitarbeiter Datenmanagement & KI (m/w/d)
description: Sie verstehen Daten, denken in Prozessen und haben Freude daran, digitale Abläufe zu verbessern? Dann gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Versicherungsverwaltung. Die Finanz Protect GmbH ist ein Finanz- und Versicherungsmakler mit Sitz am Phoenixsee in Dortmund und betreut Kunden bundesweit. Wir wachsen und suchen Unterstützung für unser Daten- und Schnittstellenmanagement sowie für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Automatisierungs- und KI-Prozesse. Bei uns sorgen Sie dafür, dass Kunden- und Vertragsdaten zuverlässig verarbeitet werden, Systeme miteinander kommunizieren und aus manuellen Arbeitsschritten effiziente digitale Abläufe werden. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit der Geschäftsführung, unserem Team und externen Softwarepartnern zusammen. Aufgaben Datenmanagement und Datenqualität: Sie pflegen und strukturieren Kunden- und Vertragsdaten in unserem Maklerverwaltungsprogramm, erkennen Dubletten und Unstimmigkeiten und sorgen für eine verlässliche Datenbasis. BiPRO-Abruf: Sie richten digitale Abrufe von Versicherungsdokumenten und Daten ein, überwachen deren Verarbeitung und stellen die korrekte Zuordnung zu Kunden und Verträgen sicher. GDV-Datenverarbeitung: Sie importieren und verarbeiten GDV-Bestandsdaten, gleichen diese mit vorhandenen Datensätzen ab und klären fehlerhafte oder unvollständige Übertragungen. Schnittstellenmanagement: Sie betreuen die Anbindungen zwischen Maklerverwaltungsprogramm, Versicherern, Maklerpools und weiteren Anwendungen. Bei Störungen koordinieren Sie die Fehleranalyse und Behebung mit den jeweiligen Ansprechpartnern. Bestandsintegration: Sie unterstützen die Übernahme zugekaufter Versicherungsbestände durch die Aufbereitung, Übertragung und Qualitätskontrolle der Kunden- und Vertragsdaten. Automatisierung: Sie identifizieren wiederkehrende manuelle Aufgaben und entwickeln automatisierte Abläufe, beispielsweise für Dokumentenzuordnung, Datenpflege und interne Bearbeitungsprozesse. KI- Prozesse: Sie erproben und integrieren KI-Anwendungen für die Dokumentenerkennung, Informationsextraktion und Unterstützung im Tagesgeschäft. Dabei prüfen Sie die Ergebnisse auf Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit. Dokumentation und Wissenstransfer: Sie dokumentieren Abläufe verständlich und unterstützen das Team bei der sicheren Anwendung neuer digitaler Prozesse. Qualifikation Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Versicherungsbereich, in der IT oder im kaufmännischen Bereich mit ausgeprägtem technischem Schwerpunkt – oder über vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung. Sie bringen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Versicherungsdaten, Maklerverwaltungsprogrammen oder digitalen Verwaltungsprozessen mit. Kenntnisse in BiPRO, GDV-Datenverarbeitung und Schnittstellenmanagement sind besonders willkommen. In einzelne Themen können Sie sich bei entsprechender Vorerfahrung und Lernbereitschaft einarbeiten. Sie arbeiten sicher mit Excel und können Daten strukturiert aufbereiten, abgleichen und auf Fehler prüfen. Sie haben praktische Erfahrung mit Automatisierungswerkzeugen wie Make oder Power Automate beziehungsweise großes Interesse, sich darin zu vertiefen. Sie nutzen KI-Anwendungen praxisorientiert und können beurteilen, an welchen Stellen diese sinnvoll eingesetzt werden und wo eine menschliche Prüfung erforderlich bleibt. Kenntnisse in APIs, Datenformaten wie CSV, XML oder JSON sowie grundlegende Programmierkenntnisse sind ein Plus. Sie arbeiten sorgfältig, analytisch und eigenverantwortlich. Auch bei komplexen Datenbeständen behalten Sie den Überblick und gehen Fehlern systematisch auf den Grund. Sie gehen verantwortungsbewusst mit sensiblen Kunden- und Vertragsdaten um und können technische Zusammenhänge verständlich vermitteln. Benefits Unsere Benefits für Mitarbeiter/innen: Eine Position mit Gestaltungsspielraum und direktem Einfluss auf unsere digitale Weiterentwicklung Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung, kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien Modernes Büro im RIVA-Gebäude am Phoenixsee in Dortmund Moderne Software, KI-Anwendungen und technische Ausstattung Monatliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung Flexibles Gleitzeitmodell Attraktive Mitarbeiterkonditionen für eigene Versicherungen und Depots Betriebliche Altersversorgung mit Zuschuss Über 300 Gesundheitsleistungen, darunter Physiotherapie, Zahnreinigung, Brillenzuschüsse und Massagen Premium-Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft inklusive Sauna Höhenverstellbare Schreibtische und ergonomische Bürostühle Kostenfreie Getränke wie Wasser, Kaffee und Softdrinks Bei der Finanz Protect GmbH legen wir großen Wert auf das Wohlbefinden und die Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeiter . Wir bieten Ihnen nicht nur spannende Aufgaben und vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten , sondern auch attraktive Benefits , um Ihnen den Arbeitsalltag angenehm zu gestalten. Sie möchten Daten nicht nur verwalten, sondern dafür sorgen, dass Prozesse besser funktionieren? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen. Senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf und erzählen Sie uns kurz, mit welchen Systemen, Schnittstellen oder Automatisierungen Sie bereits gearbeitet haben. title: (Senior) Custody Operations Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

The Custody & Principal Broking team serves as the backbone of Raisin Bank’s Digital Wealth Management (DWM) division, providing the secure, scalable foundation essential for retail investing. We manage the complex infrastructure, from securities trading mechanics to outsourcing oversight that ensures operational resilience and regulatory compliance. As our retail customer base grows, we are focused on continuous process optimization and high-volume scalability, ensuring our platforms remain reliable, secure, and fully compliant with BaFin standards. We are currently seeking a Senior Operations Manager to join this mission.

Your Responsibilities

  • Strategic Process Optimization: You will drive the evolution of operational workflows to ensure they are scalable and resilient, directly supporting high-volume retail growth.
  • Operational Controls & Oversight: You will define and execute the control framework for daily securities processing, ensuring rigorous validation of all outsourced clearing and settlement activities.
  • Regulatory Compliance: You will partner with Compliance, Legal, and Risk teams to navigate the regulatory landscape and maintain strict adherence to German financial regulations (including KWG, WpHG, and MaRisk).
  • Operational Resilience: You will proactively investigate, moderate, and resolve complex securities discrepancies and trade breaks in close collaboration with cross-functional internal and external stakeholders.
  • Due Diligence & Auditing: You will actively support due diligence activities and comprehensive audits for both current and prospective outsourcing partners.
  • Strategic Project Contribution: You will provide subject matter expertise for internal and external strategic initiatives, including product launches, platform upgrades, and system migrations.

Your Profile

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a completed banking apprenticeship (Bankkaufmann/-frau) with relevant further qualifications.
  • Experience: 7+ years of operations experience within a custodian bank (Depotbank), clearing firm, or retail broker in the German/European market.
  • Private Customer Expertise: Direct experience with mass-affluent and high-volume retail accounts, managing the complexities of fractional shares, and savings plans (Sparpläne).
  • Technical & Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of Clearstream Banking Frankfurt (CBF), T2S, and European post-trade infrastructure.
  • Risk & Controls: Proven background in establishing and executing internal controls, particularly within the context of MaRisk and outsourced operations.
  • Language Skills: Business fluency in both German and English is required.

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

  • Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.
  • Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.
  • A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.
  • Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month. 
  • Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.
  • Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.
  • Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.
  • You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.

Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy

We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

title: Strategic Core Account Executive - Insurance, m/f/d
description:
SLSQ427149

Databricks operates at the leading edge of the unified data, analytics and AI space. Our customers turn to us to lead the accelerated innovation their businesses need to gain first‑mover advantage in today’s ultra‑competitive landscape.

As we continue our rapid expansion across Central Europe, we are looking for a creative, execution‑oriented Strategic Account Executive to join the team in Germany and maximise the phenomenal market opportunity that exists for Databricks within the insurance vertical. Reporting to our Senior Director of Enterprise Sales, you will focus on building relationships and closing new business opportunities within one of Germany’s largest Reinsurers, based in Munich. You will be part of an account team supporting this highly strategic client. Leveraging your consultative sales experience in the Insurance/FSI vertical, you will help shape the data and AI strategy, identify and progress high-value opportunities, and deliver tangible business outcomes.

The impact you will have:

  • You will take ownership of your flagship account, define a clear strategy, and relentlessly drive it to exceed revenue and consumption goals.

  • You will turn that strategy into action, executing with urgency and discipline to consistently overachieve your targets.

  • You will build boardroom‑level relationships, becoming the trusted advisor on all things data and AI for senior stakeholders up to and including C‑level.

  • You will uncover and shape new business, expanding use cases and driving deeper platform consumption across your account.

  • You will orchestrate the full Databricks ecosystem, mobilising internal teams to maximise impact and customer value.

  • You will demonstrate compelling value in every engagement, leading confident, insight‑led negotiations that take opportunities all the way to close.

What we look for

  • A proven record of exceeding revenue targets in complex enterprise sales environments.

  • Recognised insurance domain expertise, applied to expanding strategic Insurance/FSI accounts in Germany through deep understanding of regulatory, risk, and compliance dynamics.

  • Proven success selling data, analytics, big data, AI, or other highly technical cloud software solutions through complex, multi-stakeholder, multi-year enterprise sales cycles

  • The ability to identify high-impact data and AI use cases and engage key buying centres to expand Databricks’ footprint and strategic relevance within an organisation.

  • Strong understanding of consumption-based, land-and-expand models, with the ability to drive sustained growth within a single strategic account.

  • Demonstrated ability to create and shape demand, translating customer priorities into measurable business value.

  • Disciplined use of sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, account planning, Value Selling, or Command of the Message, combined with strong pipeline management and accurate forecasting.

  • A track record of building executive-level champions and cross-functional account teams to execute against a defined account and territory strategy.

  • Experience developing and executing partner strategies that extend reach, accelerate deal velocity, and support complex enterprise opportunities.

  • Willing and able to travel to customer sites, company and industry events - regionally and internationally

  • Fluent in German and English, with the credibility to engage, challenge, and influence senior stakeholders up to C-level.

 

 

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Als Senior Manager Paid Search (Mensch) bist du für das Management und die Optimierung von bezahlten Suchmaschinenwerbekampagnen verantwortlich. Darüber hinaus übernimmst du folgende Aufgaben:

  • Strategische Kundenentwicklung: Du bist hauptverantwortlich für die strategische Beratung und Weiterentwicklung deiner Kunden und erarbeitest maßgeschneiderte Paid-Search-Strategien.

  • Budgetverantwortung: Du trägst die Verantwortung für attraktive Mediabudgets, inklusive deren strategischer Planung, Kontrolle und des Reportings an den Kunden.
  • Performance-Analyse: Als treibende Kraft in der Optimierung führst du tiefgehende Analysen von Performance-Daten durch und präsentierst strategische Beratungsansätze souverän vor dem Kunden.
  • Spezialisierung & Innovation: Du hast die Möglichkeit, dich auf eigene Verantwortungsbereiche zu spezialisieren, diese weiterzuentwickeln und aktiv Trends sowie Innovationen im Paid Search Umfeld voranzutreiben.

 

Das zeichnet dich aus:

  • SEA-Expertise: Im Bereich der Suchmaschinenwerbung (SEA) kennst du dich bestens aus und das Setup sowie die Steuerung von komplexen Kampagnen sind dir vertraut.
  • Führungskompetenz: Du bringst erste Führungserfahrung mit und hast Freude daran, juniorige Teammitglieder anzuleiten und dein Wissen aktiv weiterzugeben.
  • Strategisches Denken: Deine Fähigkeit, strategisch zu denken, ermöglicht es dir, umfassende Konzepte für die Kundenweiterentwicklung zu erarbeiten und überzeugend zu präsentieren.
  • Analytische Fähigkeiten: Mit deiner ausgeprägten Zahlenaffinität und analytischem Verständnis bist du in der Lage, komplexe Datenanalysen selbstständig durchzuführen und daraus strategische Empfehlungen abzuleiten.
  • Kundenorientierung: Du besitzt Erfahrung in der strategischen Kundenberatung, verstehst es, auf Kundenbedürfnisse einzugehen und trittst dabei überzeugend auf.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Eine hohe Eigeninitiative und der Wunsch, eigene Verantwortungsbereiche zu spezialisieren und weiterzuentwickeln, zeichnen deine Arbeitsweise aus.

 

 

Darüber hinaus bist du: #neugierig #teamplayer #motiviert

Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.

Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.

Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation. Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates. Translate data into clear insights that guide decision-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams. Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes. Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning. What You Need to Be Great in This Role Essential Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments. Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design. Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance. Demonstrable experience combining sell-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight. Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels. Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e-commerce KPIs. Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar. Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non-technical audiences. Experience working with multi-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions. A passion for data-driven decision-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows. Preferred: Proficiency in Python (pandas) for data transformation, automation and workflow scripting. Broader experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including automating data ingestion and transformation workflows. Experience working in retail, e-commerce or retailer media environments. Familiarity with GfK or other syndicated market data sources. Experience with additional BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI. We are now looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our onsite team supporting in London. 

About the Role 

As the Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering insight that drives improvements across the full commercial ecosystem spanning customer experience on, retailer investment effectiveness, marketing and sales performance, and the broader post-purchase, onboarding and promotional landscape. 

A core part of your remit will be the design, build and ongoing management of a marketing and sales performance dashboard, underpinned by Google BigQuery and delivered in Looker Studio. This will serve as a critical decision-making tool for marketing, e-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets. 

Alongside this, you will analyse customer journeys, benchmark competitors, oversee content performance and support the planning and execution of onboarding and e-commerce promotions using platforms like GWI to create digital personas and audience profiles. 

You will collaborate closely with CX, marketing, product and e-commerce teams as well as HQ and local market stakeholders to ensure insight informs decisions at every stage. 

This role requires strong analytical capability, expertise in data modelling and SQL, and the ability to translate complex commercial questions into dashboard logic and actionable recommendations. 

What You Will Be Doing 

Marketing & Sales Performance Analytics  

  • Design, build and maintain a marketing and sales performance dashboard in Looker Studio, underpinned by BigQuery, combining sell-out sales data, market volume and share data, and campaign activity logs. 
  • Define the underlying data model, transform source files and design the reporting layer to support consistent, scalable KPI delivery. 
  • Identify and quantify the impact of retailer investment, including uplift in sales and market share during campaign periods. 
  • Analyse correlations between campaign activity and commercial performance to determine which marketing levers are most effective. 
  • Measure and report on halo effects across products and retailers resulting from promotional and campaign activity. 
  • Define and calculate key performance metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Work with GFK or other syndicated market data sources to enrich performance analysis with market volume and share context. 

Customer Experience & Digital Analytics 

  • Conduct analysis of the current customer experience, including user behaviour, content and campaign performance and conversion pathways. 
  • Benchmark key customer journeys against competitor websites to identify gaps and opportunities. 
  • Provide regular insight into paid promotions, post-purchase experience and customer satisfaction trends. 
  • Support planning, optimisation and operational management of post-purchase and onboarding experience. 
  • Analyse content utilisation, engagement and drop-off points, and recommend enhancements. 
  • Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation. 
  • Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates. 
  • Reporting, Dashboards & Stakeholder Insight 
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports and ad hoc analyses across customer experience, onboarding, e-commerce, retail performance and promotion activity. 
  • Translate data into clear insights that guide decision-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams. 
  • Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes. 
  • Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning. 

What You Need to Be Great in This Role 

Essential 

  • Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments. 
  • Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design. 
  • Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance. 
  • Demonstrable experience combining sell-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight. 
  • Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels. 
  • Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e-commerce KPIs. 
  • Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar. 
  • Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non-technical audiences. 
  • Experience working with multi-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions. 
  • A passion for data-driven decision-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows. 

Preferred: 

  • Proficiency in Python (pandas) for data transformation, automation and workflow scripting. 
  • Broader experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including automating data ingestion and transformation workflows. 
  • Experience working in retail, e-commerce or retailer media environments. 
  • Familiarity with GfK or other syndicated market data sources. 
  • Experience with additional BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

You will own the complete sensing architecture—from evaluating tactile technologies and proprioceptive layouts to designing readout electronics, calibration matrix algorithms, and real-time sensor pipelines. Fitting high-density sensing skins, force feedback, and position tracking into a tight hand envelope means balancing signal integrity, low latency, and mechanical durability under high cyclic wear. You will work closely with Mechanics, Electronics, and Software to turn raw physical contact into clean, reliable data for real-time robotic control. What you will do: Own the sensing architecture. Develop tactile array hardware. Engineer proprioceptive feedback. Implement joint- and drive-level feedback mechanisms, including high-precision position/angle sensing, strain gauge force bridges, load cells, and tendinous tension tracking. Design readout electronics & AFEs. Build low-noise analog front-ends (AFEs), signal conditioning circuits, and local readout hardware optimized for minimal latency, wide dynamic range, and high immunity to electromagnetic interference (EMI). Build calibration & processing pipelines. Implement automated calibration protocols, thermal/drift compensation matrix algorithms, and feature extraction (e.g., slip detection, contact point estimation) to feed clean telemetry to the software stack. Characterize & validate on real hardware. Own sensor testing on custom rigs—evaluating dynamic response, force linearity, hysteresis, spatial resolution, and long-term mechanical wear over hundreds of thousands of cycles. Drive sensor manufacturing & yield. Partner with specialized suppliers on Design for Manufacturing (DFM) for flexible/rigid-flex PCBs, molded tactile skins, and elastomeric components, ensuring high assembly yield and second-sourcing. Work across the whole team. Tight loop with Mechanics (for load paths and physical packaging), Electronics (for board interfaces), and Software (for state estimation and closed-loop grasp control). What you bring: Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, Sensorics, Robotics, or a related field. 5–10 years of experience developing sensor hardware, mechatronic instrumentation, or sensor fusion systems, including at least one product taken into series production. Deep domain expertise in tactile sensing modalities (e.g., optical tactile/GelSight style, piezoresistive, capacitive) or high-density proprioceptive feedback (encoders, strain gauges, load cells). Proven experience in analog circuit design, signal conditioning (AFE), active filtering, and high-SNR data acquisition for physical sensors. Hands-on experience with sensor calibration techniques, thermal/hysteresis modeling, signal processing, and standard communication buses (SPI, I2C, CAN). Practical experience designing or integrating flexible PCBs, molded elastomers, or miniaturized mechatronic assemblies into tight physical envelopes. A strong hardware mindset: you enjoy lab bring-up, sensor characterization on test rigs, and tracing physics-to-signal anomalies with scopes and logic analyzers. Fluent in English; German is a plus, not a requirement. Bonus: Background in real-time embedded C/C++ firmware or ROS/ROS2 for sensor data processing and filtering. Experience with tactile algorithms for slip prediction, texture recognition, or contact shape estimation. Experience with soft robotics, stretchable electronics, or conductive polymers. Knowledge of Machinery Regulation, ISO/TS 15066, and sensor design for collaborative applications. The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. description: Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co . We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions About the Role At Applied Intuition, you will sit directly at the intersection of System Integration and Validation . Rather than just running pre-written scripts, you will build and configure Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL) environments from scratch. We need a systemic thinker who thrives in ambiguity—someone who can take incomplete requirements, bridge functional gaps independently, and connect dots across the entire vehicle architecture while working closely with OEM partners. What You’ll Do Assemble, configure, and initialize dSPACE and Vector HiL test benches, lab cars, and test environments from the ground up for new projects. Build and integrate complex vehicle simulation models in MATLAB/Simulink and link them directly with HiL hardware systems. Analyze high-level system requirements, bridge functional gaps, and design complete validation strategies—even when documentation is minimal or incomplete.   • Produce a steady cadence of compelling customer stories across formats: written case studies, video, slide-ready summaries, and co-branded content

  • Build and manage a customer reference and advocacy program — identifying, recruiting, and nurturing customer advocates without burning them out

  • Identify and develop upsell-ready customer segments — working with Product Marketing, CS and Sales to create marketing programs that convert engaged, high-adoption customers into expansion pipeline for additional products

Analyst Relations

  • Own management of the AR program: help design annual strategy, briefing preparation, inquiry management, evaluation cycles, and ongoing analyst engagement

  • Lead briefing preparation: working across product, product marketing, and leadership to build crisp, evidence-backed narratives and prep executive spokespeople

  • Maintain an AR intelligence function — tracking analyst sentiment, surfacing relevant research, and feeding competitive and market insights back to product and go-to-market teams

  • Help maintain genuine relationships with tier-1 and tier-2 analysts, understanding what each analyst cares about and tailoring our engagement accordingly

 
 

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 3+ years of experience in customer marketing: running campaigns specifically designed to drive customer engagement (product adoption and advocacy)

  • Has run multiple customer-focused programs end-to-end (loyalty campaigns, onboarding journeys, expansion/upsell plays, customer advisory boards, etc)

  • Heavy involvement in content creation — case studies, customer stories, or executive communications

  • Experience working with CRM data (Salesforce) and customer lifecycle metrics (NPS, CSAT, expansion signals)

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with product, sales, and executive stakeholders to gather input and drive alignment

Preferred

  • Has managed a customer reference or advocacy program

Skills

Für unsere Geschäftsführung bist du dabei ein Key Sparrings Partner. Business Impact & strategische Analysen: Du erstellst Entscheidungsgrundlagen, Business Cases und Analysen zu zentralen strategischen Fragestellungen und stellst sicher, dass strategische Prioritäten effizient umgesetzt werden. Business Transformation: Du identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale in Prozessen und Strukturen innerhalb eines oder über Teams hinweg und treibst die kontinuierliche organisatorische Weiterentwicklung. Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit den Executive und Leadership Teams sowie den Fachbereichen zusammen, koordinierst über Teamgrenzen hinweg und sorgst für eine reibungslose Umsetzung. Stakeholder Management : Du bist eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unserem CEO, der Geschäftsführung und externen Stakeholdern. Du pflegst du den Kontakt zu Partnern und Investoren, bereitest Updates und Unterlagen vor und unterstützt den CEO und die Geschäftsführung bei strategischen Diskussionen. Das bringst du mit: Akademischer Background: Ein exzellenter Abschluss einer Top-Tier Business School, Wirtschafts- oder Technischen Universität mit Schwerpunkt auf Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Management oder angrenzenden Bereichen. Berufserfahrung: mind. 5 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Bereich Strategieberatung, Investment Banking, Private Equity oder Venture Capital bzw. in einer vergleichbaren strategischen Rolle (idealerweise mit Bezug zu Financial Services oder Tech Scale-Ups). Projektmanagement: Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Leitung und Umsetzung komplexer Projekte mit mehreren Stakeholdern. Analytische & strategische Fähigkeiten: Eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe, ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Zahlen und ein hohes Maß an Detailorientierung. Kommunikationsstärke: Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten in schriftlicher und mündlicher Kommunikation auf deutschsprachigem Muttersprachniveau sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse. Hands-on-Mentalität: Eigeninitiative, Durchsetzungsvermögen und die Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen Umfeld pragmatische Lösungen zu finden. Das bieten wir dir: Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten. Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten. Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen. Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500€. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display. Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern. Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten Dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus. So geht es für dich weiter Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte. Kurzes Kennenlerngespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team: Ein entspannter erster Austausch, bei dem wir uns gegenseitig kennenlernen. Videointerview mit dem Hiring Manager: Wir besprechen, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Rolle zu unseren Anforderungen passen. Case Study: Wir möchten sehen, wie du komplexe Herausforderungen angehst und deine Problemlösungskompetenz anhand eines realistischen Arbeitsszenarios unter Beweis stellst. Persönliches Kennenlernen: Du lernst das Team kennen und erhältst praxisnahe Einblicke in den Arbeitsalltag. Über uns Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit. Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem verwalteten Vermögen von über 3,8 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT , Toscafund , HQ Trust und Project A zusammen. LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. description: Your Role As Senior Product Manager – Client Experience & Engagement (f/m/d) you own everything that happens after a client's first investment. You shape the digital home of our clients across web and native app: portfolio reporting, performance insights, documents, settings and self-services, and you turn it into an experience worthy of a premium wealth manager. Our clients hold portfolios that include private equity funds from KKR, EQT, CVC and Permira and venture stakes in companies like SpaceX, Anthropic, OpenAI, Stripe and Anduril. You design how these investments are experienced, understood and told as a story in the product. Your mandate is twofold: make the day-to-day experience exceptional, and grow the relationship through digital up- and cross-sell of additional portfolios, products and account types. LIQID is hybrid by design, so you build a digital experience in which the personal Relationship Manager is natively woven in rather than bolted on. Clients should never feel a seam between their app and their advisor. What you'll do • End-to-End Client Experience Ownership: Own the active client journey from first investment onward across web and native app. You set the vision for portfolio reporting, portfolio KPIs and performance communication, document management, account settings and self-services, and you raise the quality bar until the digital experience matches the standard of our investment products. That includes the storytelling layer for private markets: making capital calls, distributions, J-curves and the underlying funds and companies, from Cinven and Advent to Mistral and Databricks, tangible and understandable for clients. You define and evolve the North Star and KPI tree for active clients, building on our existing engagement framework (top-ups, additional portfolio and account openings, share of wallet, dashboard engagement, self-service completion) and developing it further where you see sharper signals. • Digital Up- & Cross-Sell: Design and scale the journeys that deepen client relationships: time to first top-up, second portfolio and second product adoption, additional account types (joint, kids), and share-of-wallet growth. You identify natural product sequences through path and cohort analysis, build in-product moments and lifecycle campaigns that convert them, and prove your impact with honest, causal measurement rather than correlation stories. You build repeatable growth systems for the existing client base instead of one-off campaigns. • Hybrid Experience & RM Integration: Make the Relationship Manager a first-class citizen of the digital product. You design how human advice surfaces inside the app: contextual RM touchpoints, seamless handovers between self-service and personal consultation, and self-service flows for major actions (top-ups, strategy changes, tax documents) that reduce friction without reducing trust. You measure and improve the interplay between RM engagement and client outcomes, from retention to share of wallet. • Discovery, Data & Experimentation: Run continuous discovery with clients and Relationship Managers to understand what HNW clients actually need from their wealth dashboard. You define tracking schemas and metric contracts for the active client domain, run experiments and cohort analyses across engagement, retention and multi-product adoption, and use AI-assisted prototyping to converge on solutions in few iteration cycles. You act as Product Manager and Product Owner for a cross-functional squad of Engineering and Design, and prioritize with a transparent impact and effort logic that also means saying no. What you bring • Background: 7+ years of experience in Product Management for digital consumer products, ideally in FinTech, WealthTech, banking or another trust-driven domain. Experience with engagement, retention or CRM-driven product work is a strong plus, as is exposure to native app development. • Analytical & Technical Fluency: Hands-on experience with product analytics, funnel and cohort analysis, and experimentation. You define metrics before you build, establish baselines, and attribute impact credibly. You are comfortable discussing architecture and API trade-offs with engineers and use AI tooling to prototype and compress your own cycles. • Domain Curiosity & Client Empathy: Genuine interest in investing and wealth management (capital markets, private markets, portfolio construction) and the ambition to build regulatory fluency in a supervised environment. You understand that our clients entrust us with significant wealth and that every pixel of the experience either builds or erodes that trust. • Communication & Language: Fluent in English (German a plus!), able to align Product, Design, Engineering, CRM and Relationship Management around one coherent client experience, and to represent your roadmap credibly toward leadership. • Drive & Motivation: Comfortable in fast-paced, high-ownership scale-up environments. You want to own outcomes, not backlogs, and you are excited to define what a premium hybrid wealth experience looks like in an AI-native product organization. Don’t meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to receiving your application. What we offer Diversity: Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one. Flexibility: We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind. Appreciation: You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas. Development: We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget of €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display. Smart Money: As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers. Well-being: Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that. What happens next An excellent candidate experience and a high level of transparency are our top priorities throughout the interview process. The different stages of the application process are designed to help us understand what a potential collaboration could look like. Short introductory call with our Recruiting team: A relaxed first get-to-know-each-other conversation. Video interview with the Hiring Manager: We discuss whether your experience and expectations for the role align with our requirements. Case study: We would like to see how you approach complex challenges and demonstrate your problem-solving skills in a realistic work scenario. In-person meeting: You meet the team and gain practical insights into the day-to-day work. About us We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit. We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions – ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €3.8 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including LGT , Toscafund , HQ Trust , and Project A . LIQID is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applications are considered without regard to race, age, religion, gender, ethnic or national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable equal opportunity laws. title: Werkstudent:in Content & Social Media (m/w/d)
description: Worum es geht Wir sind OK ROGER. Im Kern eine Markenberatung: Unsere Kunden können etwas — nur sieht man es ihnen oft nicht an. Zwischen dem, was sie sind, und dem, was ankommt, liegt Rauschen. Wir räumen es weg. Aber Markenberatung ist nur eine Sparte. Wir wachsen gerade stark und unternehmerisch, in mehrere Richtungen gleichzeitig. Für dich heißt das: Du steigst über einen klaren Bereich ein — und bleibst nicht darauf beschränkt. Dein Einstieg ist die Content-Produktion für unsere Social-Media-Kunden. Das ist der Anfang, nicht die Decke. Weil wir wachsen, wächst die Rolle mit — in mehr Verantwortung, in neue Bereiche, so weit du willst. Was du bei uns machst Dein Einstieg: Content für unsere Kunden. Du produzierst Content: Redaktionsplanung, Grafik und Text, fertige Posts — mit eigener Handschrift. Du bringst eigene Ideen mit. Formate, Aufhänger, Posts — nicht nur Umsetzung, sondern Einfälle. Am Anfang arbeitest du eng an unserer Seite. Nach dem Onboarding übernimmst du eigene Kunden — du planst, produzierst und verantwortest ihren Auftritt, wir schauen nur noch an den richtigen Stellen drauf. Du holst Freigaben bei Kunden ein und stimmst Operatives ab. Die Kundenbeziehung selbst bleibt bei uns. Du hältst die Qualität, auch im Detail. Bei uns liest der Markt Sorgfalt als Substanz. Dein Blick über den Tellerrand. Du arbeitest eng mit uns zusammen und bekommst Einblick, wo andere Werkstudierende nie hinkommen: wie eine Beratung geführt wird, wie Entscheidungen fallen, wie aus einer Idee ein Unternehmen wird. Konkret packst du beim Aufbau eines weiteren unternehmerischen Projekts mit an, das wir gerade hochziehen. Ja, manches davon ist Organisieren und Mitdenken im Alltag. Aber nichts davon ist Beschäftigung — jede Aufgabe zeigt dir ein Stück davon, wie Unternehmen entstehen. So fängst du an — und wohin es gehen kann Wir werfen dich nicht ins kalte Wasser. Die ersten Wochen arbeitest du eng an unserer Seite und lernst, wie wir arbeiten. Danach wirst du Schritt für Schritt eigenständiger. Und dann? Bei uns führt kein einziger Weg nach oben, sondern mehrere nach vorne: Tiefer in den Content. Von einzelnen Posts zu eigenen Kunden, die du verantwortest. Breiter ins Unternehmen. Mit in ein weiteres Vorhaben, mit in Bereiche, die gerade erst entstehen. Mehr Verantwortung. Wer zeigt, dass er trägt, bekommt mehr zu tragen. Langfristig. Passt es für beide, wächst die Rolle über das Studium hinaus. Kein Versprechen in einer Anzeige — aber eine echte Möglichkeit, wenn du Lust hast. Was du mitbringst Du hast eigene Ideen und Lust, mitzuwachsen. Du willst nicht nur abarbeiten, sondern dazulernen. Du bist auf den gängigen Social-Media-Plattformen zuhause — du weißt, was gerade funktioniert und warum. Du arbeitest sicher mit den gängigen Tools — Canva und/oder Adobe, CapCut, Meta Business Suite oder vergleichbaren Planungstools. Du textest und gestaltest sicher genug, dass ein Post ohne uns fertig wird. Profi in beidem musst du nicht sein — den Rest schärfen wir gemeinsam. Du hast Haltung und Empathie — du spürst, was ein Mensch oder eine Marke eigentlich sagen will. Du bist verlässlich und genau. Wenn du sagst, etwas ist fertig, ist es fertig. Du studierst im Bereich Marketing, digitale Medien, Medienwissenschaften, Design o. Ä. Du schreibst und sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau. Was du nicht brauchst Kein Portfolio mit fünf Jahren Agentenerfahrung. Du musst noch nicht alles können. Wichtiger ist, dass du es lernen willst. Keinen geraden Lebenslauf. Uns interessiert, wie du denkst — nicht, ob bisher alles glattlief. Was du bekommst Das ist keine Kaffeeholen-Stelle mit Zeugniszeile am Ende. Du nimmst mit: Echte Projekte, echte Marken. Du übst nicht an erfundenen Fällen — du arbeitest an Kunden, die es wirklich gibt, und siehst, was deine Arbeit bei ihnen auslöst. Ein Netzwerk, das dir sonst verschlossen bliebe. Wir kennen viele Menschen — Gründer:innen, Unternehmer:innen, Entscheider:innen. Bei uns lernst du sie kennen. Unternehmertum von innen. Bei einem Projekt, das gerade entsteht, siehst du zu, wie aus einer Idee ein Unternehmen wird — die Entscheidungen, nicht nur die Ergebnisse. Das lernt man in keinem Seminar. Kurze Wege. Du fragst uns direkt, nicht drei Ebenen hoch. Feedback ehrlich, Entscheidungen schnell. 17 € pro Stunde. So sieht dein Rahmen aus Du startest mit mindestens 10 Stunden pro Woche. Passt es — für dich und für uns —, können wir auf bis zu 20 Stunden aufstöcken. Du arbeitest überwiegend remote und flexibel um dein Studium herum. Zum Zusammenarbeiten haben wir einen Tisch im Coworking-Space SpaceDus auf der Moltkestraße — da kommen wir zusammen, wenn es hilft. So bewirbst du dich Kein Motivationsschreiben. Schick uns stattdessen: kurz, wer du bist, und wo (Studium, ab wann, wie viele Stunden), ein, zwei Sachen, die du gemacht hast (Post, Grafik, Text — egal wie klein), und eine Antwort auf diese Frage: Zeig uns einen Auftritt — eine Marke, ein Mensch, ein Produkt — der besser ist als sein Bild. Was würdest du in einem einzigen Post daran ändern? Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Sage 100 und Candis sind ein Plus. KI-Affinität: Du nutzt KI-Tools bereits im Arbeitsalltag - oder hast Lust, damit anzufangen. raw.title: Account Executive – Full-Cycle, New Business (m/f/d)
raw.description:
THE JOB

Reading this to the end is worth it.

The Company: Why mute-labs?


mute-labs is the EU market leader in acoustic phone booths, with more than 20,000 cabins sold and counting. We are self-funded, profitable since day one, and have no investors to answer to and no exit to chase. What we do have is a steep growth curve in revenue, a product made in Germany, and a genuine mission: giving the modern office some quiet back.


We have built a strong direct and dealer business on the back of inbound demand and word of mouth. What we have not built yet is a real outbound engine for winning bigger accounts on purpose, from ambitious growth companies to household names like Volkswagen, adidas, IKEA, Red Bull, or Axel Springer, who already trust us today. That gap is this role, and how far into that world you grow is largely up to you.


Outbound is not a new idea for us. We have piloted it in smaller pockets already, testing signal-based outreach and structured sequences with real results. What has been missing is someone to own this as a dedicated motion for bigger accounts rather than a side project squeezed in between other things. That is why we are building this out as a new department and you’d be joining a small, yet focussed team as one of the first hires.


The Role: Build the Pipeline AND the Channel


This is a founding position. You are not stepping into an existing sales org with a quota handed down from three reps before you. You are the first one in the building. What you build, and how you build it, is largely up to you and your team, and you can grow the size and ambition of your target accounts as you find your footing.


  • Green Field, Full Ownership: Build your own pipeline from scratch. There is no inherited book of business and no recycled leads. The customer base you build is yours, and so is the revenue you generate from it.

  • Your Stack, Your Sequences: Clay, Reply.io, LinkedIn Premium, and Aircall are all at your disposal. You design your own outreach sequences, run your own cold calling campaigns, and decide how the machine works. Nobody hands you a script.

  • Segment Strategy, Together: You understand the market as well as anyone. Rather than being handed a target list from above, you and your manager will decide together which segments and account types are worth focusing on.

  • Comp That Rewards More Than the First Deal: An uncapped bonus with a kicker for overperformance. Returning customers you bring in keep feeding your comp over time, not just the initial close. Landing an account well is worth more than landing it once.

  • A Brand That Opens Doors: You are not cold-calling on behalf of an unknown startup. mute-labs is an established, well-regarded market leader with a reference list that already includes some of the biggest names in German and European business. That credibility is yours to use from day one.

  • A seasoned team to back you up: Your manager has built and run outbound and enterprise sales hands-on, from cold pipeline to six-figure closes, and will work closely with you from day one, coaching, supporting, and training wherever it's actually needed rather than just checking in on numbers.


Is This You?


  • The Go-Getter: You do not wait to be told what to do next. You get on your feet quickly, figure out the shape of the problem, and start moving before anyone has to push you.

  • Sales Experience: You have carried a full sales cycle before, from first contact to signed contract, and know how to keep a deal moving without needing someone else to close it for you. You do not need to have sold into large enterprises already, that is something you will grow into here.

  • Stakeholder Management: You know how to work a deal with more than one person in the room, decision-makers, influencers, and budget holders, and you can keep several of those relationships moving in parallel without losing the thread.

  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: There is no existing playbook to inherit here. You will help write it. If you need every process defined for you before you can start, this is not the role.

  • Fluent in German and English: Most of your target accounts are DACH-based, though the reference list extends across the EU. Strong German is expected; English is the internal working language.


Our Hiring Process


We keep this fast and honest, on both sides.


  1. The Spark: A short intro call with our People team to check for basic fit.

  2. The deepdive: A conversation with your future manager Patrick about your experience, how you build your pipeline and how you close. Here you’ll also meet the rest of the team.

  3. The Live Action: A live discovery or negotiation role-play based on a realistic enterprise scenario. No prep deck, just show us how you actually work a deal.

  4. The Vision: A final conversation with Leah, Head of Sales as well as Franziskus, Managing Director, on the strategic mandate behind this role and where it can go from here.


ABOUT US

mute-labs exists to make quiet a normal part of the modern workplace. A few things that set us apart:


  • We are "no tech": we build and sell real hardware, sound-insulated phone and meeting booths that companies actually need.

  • We have no investors, and we are not looking for any. We have been profitable since day one.

  • We are on a steep growth curve, measured in revenue and profit, not headcount for its own sake.

  • We are not building toward an exit. We are building a company meant to last for generations.



Skip the Queue

Told you it was worth reading to the end.


We are looking for someone with a go-getter attitude who does not wait around for permission. So here is your first test: don't apply through the form. Cold call your future manager, Patrick, directly.


+49 15888 279908


If you get through and make your case, you've already shown us more than any CV could.

Location: You can choose to work at Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, Portugal, or Spain.

➡️ Mission

Join us as an Android Engineer and help us build the mobile experience that 600,000+ European businesses rely on every day to manage their finances. You'll own product-critical features end-to-end — from technical design to rollout — in a large, modular Kotlin codebase where craft and velocity both matter. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Backend, and Frontend.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Own features end-to-end: You'll take ownership from discovery and technical design through implementation, rollout, and iteration on features that help businesses pay, get paid, and stay in control.
  • Drive technical decisions in your squad: You'll shape solutions with Product, Design, and Backend by clarifying tradeoffs across UX, performance, security, and time-to-market.
  • Raise app reliability and maintainability: You'll improve architecture, performance, and test strategy to scale the app without compromising stability.
  • Tackle complex mobile challenges: You'll contribute to real-time synchronization, resilience patterns, and smooth navigation in a modular codebase with ~1,000 modules.
  • Grow the team's Android craft: You'll lead code reviews and technical discussions, share patterns, and mentor peers to raise the bar on quality and delivery.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Strong Android native experience: You've shipped and maintained production features with Kotlin and are comfortable owning technical decisions end-to-end.
  • Quality-driven mindset: You care about testing (unit, UI, snapshot), clean code, and pragmatic standards that keep teams moving fast.
  • Problem-solving approach: You thrive in ambiguity and turn complex constraints into simple, robust solutions.
  • AI-native workflow: You use AI coding tools daily to amplify your output — not just experiment with them.
  • Collaborative by nature: You're fluent in English and contribute through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentorship across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates.

  • Prospecter les cafés, restaurants, boutiques, salons et entreprises de votre secteur ;
  • Identifier leurs besoins, présenter la solution adaptée et réaliser des démonstrations ;
  • Accompagner les commerçants jusqu’à l’activation et développer votre portefeuille.

Votre rémunération

Cette activité est rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire fixe ni plafond :

  • 50 % de commission immédiate sur le matériel, les logiciels et les paiements générés par le commerçant au cours de son premier mois ;
  • 20 % de revenus récurrents sur l’activité de chaque commerçant signé, versés mensuellement pendant une durée pouvant aller jusqu’à 24 mois.

Exemple : un commerçant actif générant environ 15 000 € de volume de paiement mensuel peut vous permettre de percevoir plus de 1 000 € de commissions cumulées sur 24 mois.Ce montant indicatif varie selon les produits vendus, l’activation, le volume réel et le maintien de l’activité du commerçant. Aucun revenu minimum n’est garanti.

Vos outils et votre organisation

SumUp fournit une formation initiale, un terminal de démonstration et des supports commerciaux. Un référent de secteur reste disponible pour vous accompagner.

Votre zone est définie pendant le recrutement selon votre localisation et les secteurs ouverts. Vous organisez librement votre activité. Vos déplacements et les frais associés restent à votre charge ; aucun véhicule de fonction n’est fourni.

Votre profil

  • Au moins un an d’expérience en prospection à froid, terrain ou téléphonique, au cours des six dernières années ;
  • À l’aise dans une démarche commerciale proactive auprès de professionnels ;
  • Autonome, persévérant(e), fiable et orienté(e) résultats ;
  • Disponible au moins trois jours par semaine ;
  • Numéro SIRET valide au démarrage.

  1. Échange téléphonique avec notre équipe recrutement ;
  2. Entretien avec le ou la référente de votre secteur ;
  3. Décision rapide fondée sur votre expérience et votre motivation.

Envie de développer votre activité avec une rémunération sans plafond et des revenus récurrents potentiels ? Postulez dès maintenant !

title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
description: What Quadrants is Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research. The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton. It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. raw.title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
raw.description:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

The role

You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.

Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

It calls for two things at once: the low-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows.

The core tradeoff is settled: usability comes first. When usability and performance collide, usability wins, unless the cost is severe. We will limit what the system supports to go fast (static shapes and fixed-size allocation baked into kernels, say), but never the convenience of the API itself. Experts who want maximum performance and full control over the generated code get lower-level escape hatches, down to inline assembly, C, or PTX.

Your mandate is to build the best open-source Python compiler for physics simulation out there. No limit on what that takes. If it means replacing the entire engine, your call. Either way, you keep Quadrants healthy and unblocking the company in the meantime.

What you’ll own

  • API & authoring experience. The surface that physics and numerical-computing engineers write against, and, as an open-source library, the product’s face to the world. Idiomatic, natural to Python users, never a separate language bolted onto Python. Clean decorators, legible constraints, sharp errors, real escape hatches.

  • IR, lowering & backends. A stable IR that lowers to multiple backends, with room to grow and the door kept open for differentiable simulation. Today the computation graph is expressed through Quadrants’ own constructs. Recovering it automatically from ordinary Python is hard, and a long-term goal rather than today’s reality.

  • Optimization. Turn naive code into strong execution plans: vectorization, register and shared-memory usage, barriers and atomics, cooperative threading, dead-buffer and redundant-traffic elimination, dropping needless synchronization. Move low-level optimization off users and into the platform.

  • Primitives. Cholesky, eigendecomposition, matmul, reductions, solver kernels. Each owned with its correctness, benchmarks, and regression tracking.

  • The project as a product. Benchmark real workloads, track performance over time, catch regressions early. Stay close to users (Genesis first), find friction and missing abstractions, drive adoption, set direction.

Who you are

You reason about whole systems and have taste for where complexity should live. You measure before you optimize, and you reach for memory traffic and launch overhead before FLOPs. You have opinions about API design. You write tests and benchmarks as you go, not afterward.

  • GPU. What optimal looks like and why: access patterns, registers, shared memory, barriers, atomics, threading. CPU intuition a plus.

  • Keep the core sharp. Refactoring legacy subsystems, stronger typing, consistent coding style, less Python overhead on hot paths, full scene serialization, telemetry and replay.

Beyond the code: you review issues and pull requests with the core team, answer questions from users and contributors, and can join the push on adoption.

Who you are

You care about the engineer using what you build as much as the thing itself. A slow test, a cryptic error, a manual step: you see it, you go after the root cause, and you remove it for everyone. You have opinions about API design.

You are comfortable with physics and robotics: the right design choices take a working picture of what a simulator like Genesis-World does, how it works, and how it is used, a picture you can partly build on the job.

  • Strong Python engineering on large codebases: architecture, refactoring, typing, packaging, performance profiling (py-spy, Nsight, Xcode Instruments, RenderDoc).

  • Developer tooling, test infrastructure, or CI at scale.

  • Enough fluency with JIT compilation, code generation, or GPU computing stacks to reason about compilation caching, kernel dispatch, and startup cost. You will work closely with Quadrants.

  • At ease debugging across the full platform matrix: Windows, Linux, and macOS, on x86 and arm64, over CUDA, AMD, and Apple Metal (and possibly Intel XPU via Vulkan soon)

  • Open-source reflexes: triaging issues, reviewing external pull requests, communicating with a community.

Bonus points: experience with other robotics simulators (Drake, MuJoCo, Newton, Isaac, RaiSim, Jiminy, Brax). PyTorch, our user-facing interface. Other JIT compilers such as Triton, JAX, or Numba. 3D tooling and interactive editors (Maya, Blender, Houdini). Serialization formats (USD, glTF, MJCF/URDF). C++, CUDA, or Metal. Developer relations or community work.

The team: You’ll join the Security Operations team, responsible for protecting Ledger’s corporate, cloud, SaaS, and data center environments. Its mission: to anticipate, detect, investigate, and respond to cyber threats—including monitoring, alert triage, incident response, detection, visibility, automation, exposure tracking, and continuous process improvement. AI is at the heart of how we work: investing in AI applied to security is a strategic priority for Ledger this year. We’ve built our own in-house Agentic SOC, which autonomously investigates weak signals—the large volume of unreliable alerts that a human team couldn’t sort through manually—and enriches them, so our engineers can focus on what matters most and resolve incidents faster: high-quality detection, noise reduction, and accelerated investigations. What you’ll be doing: As a Staff Security Operations Engineer , you are the SecOps team’s top technical expert and our go-to authority on incident management. Beyond day-to-day operations, you shape the architecture of our detection pipeline, SIEM, and automation—including the management of our internal Agentic SOC—and you establish the standards, playbooks, and methodologies that raise the technical bar for the entire team. Above all, you’re a builder: beyond design, you’ll build and actively evolve our systems—the Agentic SOC, the log pipeline, and automation—with a solid understanding of the underlying infrastructure. This is an expert role (individual contributor): your impact stems from your expertise, your judgment under pressure, and your influence. Critical Incident Response (CSIRT) Serve as the primary point of contact and coordinator for the most complex incidents across the cloud, corporate systems, endpoints, identities, and the data center. Conduct end-to-end investigations: root cause analysis, forensics, timeline reconstruction, and remediation recommendations to prevent recurrence. Serve as the team’s go-to expert in incident management, ensuring a rigorous and consistent approach to handling, escalating, and documenting incidents. Detection Strategy & Threat Hunting Define the team’s detection strategy, architecture, and methodology. Lead proactive threat hunting by leveraging CTI and OSINT to identify and neutralize risks before they impact Ledger. Address the most challenging and emerging detection issues, and translate threat intelligence into concrete improvements in security posture. Architecture & Agentic SOC Design and optimize the SIEM (Splunk) architecture and SOAR (Torq) workflows that underpin effective detection, triage, and response. Bring our Splunk environment up to standard and state-of-the-art: data quality and standardization (CIM), data models, search performance, and detection governance. Build, evolve, and own the architecture of our internal Agentic SOC and our log/data pipeline, and lead the automation of reporting for the SecOps team. Apply deep expertise in cloud security (AWS, EKS/Kubernetes) and Wiz (CSPM/CNAPP) to harden the cloud and prioritize large-scale exposure. Technical Leadership & Mentoring Establish the standards, playbooks, and runbooks that the team relies on. Mentor and foster the technical growth of senior and junior engineers, and act as a force multiplier within SecOps. Work with the Engineering, Infrastructure, IT, and Cloud teams to align operational security with the organization’s objectives. What we’re looking for: 9+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, and CSIRT. A strong track record as a technical expert in incident management, threat hunting, and detection engineering. Comfortable working both as an individual contributor and as a team player in a fast-paced cloud and SaaS environment. In-depth expertise in SIEM (ideally Splunk) and SOAR platforms, as well as CTI/OSINT methodologies. Solid knowledge of AWS security (IAM, audit logs, network configurations, workloads, containers, Kubernetes) and cloud security tools (ideally Wiz, CSPM/CNAPP); experience with an EDR (ideally CrowdStrike). Strong incident response and forensics skills, with the ability to conduct complex end-to-end investigations. The ability to automate tasks and reporting using Python, Bash, APIs, GitHub Actions, a SOAR platform, or equivalent. A strong interest—or experience—in AI applied to security operations, agent-based workflows, and SOC automation. Rigor and discipline: You follow and improve established processes and ensure consistency in incident handling and reporting; excellent analytical skills, even under pressure. Clear communication of complex technical concepts to cross-functional teams; ability to document thoroughly and escalate issues with the appropriate level of context; awareness of confidentiality and the proper handling of sensitive information. This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

Pelico is a configuration-driven, AI-native platform: a field engineer stands up a running factory application by authoring YAML — schema, algorithms, widgets, actions, agents — instead of writing code. Your mission

You'll own a platform capability end to end — and ship it yourself:

  1. Build the substrate. Author the framework, SPI, runtime, or AI tooling other squads depend on, and review the rest at architectural depth.

  2. Run it as a product. Own the roadmap, the contracts your consumers rely on, the adoption metric, and the deprecation policy that keeps the surface clean.

  3. Set the bar. Author specs, run the spec-driven workflow, and stand up the eval and review gates that make agent-authored code trustworthy.

  4. Harvest the field. Turn recurring customer patterns into platform capabilities, so learning compounds instead of fragmenting into bespoke forks.

  5. Lead by example. Write the load-bearing code, pair with your engineers, raise their craft, and grow the squad as the leverage you ship earns it.

Your impact

Every Solution squad and every customer deployment is only as strong as the platform underneath it. Own a capability cluster well and you create leverage the entire company compounds on — the difference between a platform that scales and a pile of one-off forks.

What we're looking for

This is a lead-by-example role for a senior engineer who builds platforms other engineers love. You're excited by deep, high-blast-radius problems, you measure yourself by what others build on your work, and you lead by being among the best engineers in the room.

You'll need:

  • A track record of shipping production platform / framework / infrastructure that other engineers build on (SPIs, libraries, runtimes, dev tooling, or AI substrate)

  • Deep, current hands-on coding — we build in Kotlin / Java 25 (TypeScript/React for the experience squads); strong here, or a fast learner

  • Real API / SPI / abstraction-design judgment, with a feel for performance and correctness at scale (up to hundreds of millions of records)

  • A platform-as-product mindset — you optimize for adoption and others' leverage, and you're comfortable deprecating

  • A track record of leading senior engineers by example, not by leaving the keyboard

Nice to have:

  • Running a team as an internal platform (adoption metrics, internal NPS, deprecation, roadmap)

  • Squad-relevant depth — codegen/annotation processors, Kubernetes/IaC/observability, React/design systems, MCP/LSP/agent harnesses, ERP/connectors, or end-user agent UX

  • AI-native ways of working (agentic workflows, eval harnesses, spec-driven development)

  • Aerospace / defense / discrete-manufacturing context

  • French is a plus, not a requirement

What we offer

  • A real ownership mandate over a capability cluster, with equity in a category-defining scale-up

  • Deep, high-leverage problems with real customers and real scale

  • An AI-native engineering culture and a small, elite squad — be challenged, learn, and have fun

  • Hybrid working from our Paris HQ, an international team of 36+ nationalities

Your interview experience

  1. Intro call with Talent Acquisition (30 min)

  • Build and maintain robust technical and scientific dossiers for new product launches and renovations (literature reviews, scientific territories, active ingredients, performance test results).

SCIENTIFIC & COMPETITIVE INTELLIGENCE

  • Maintain active scientific and competitive watch to identify new technology, ingredients, communication territories (longevity, exposome, microbiome…) and claims opportunities.

  • Strong appetite for AI tools and agentic AI, with a genuine curiosity for experimenting with several AI-amplified projects

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (French a plus, given cross-team collaboration).

  • A creative thinker who challenges the status quo and looks for differentiating angles, not just correct ones.

  • Solution- and business-oriented mindset - resourceful in finding answers when data isn't readily available.

  • Comfortable as both a strategic thinker and a hands-on doer; flexible and able to adapt to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.

The core of the role
